notes:
- Check for Updates button on the main menu. It checks automatically when the menu opens and turns into a
  glowing, animated green-striped "UPDATE AVAILABLE" button when a newer version is out. Clicking it shows
  what's new and a Download button. Releases are published to the public repo github.com/izuwyn/zombies.
- Limb damage: shots hit the body part they land on (head, torso, arms, legs, using the zombie's pose).
  Enough damage blows off a forearm or lower leg; zombies that lose a leg become slow crawlers.
  Headshot kills make the head burst (gore spray and flying chunks). Synced in co-op.
- Knife: a real combat knife model slashes across the screen when you melee.
- Melee lunge: knifing a zombie up to 3.4 m ahead lunges you at it, so you can't just backpedal-knife.
- Knife sounds by surface: wet flesh stab on zombies, gritty concrete scrape on walls, a whoosh on a miss.
- Perk machine models: vending-machine style cabinets with a lit marquee, glowing logo panel with a
  unique icon, bottles behind glass, coin slot, dispenser tray and chrome trim.
- Perk jingles: each machine has its own original tune that plays now and then when you're nearby.
- Fixed: the first time you aimed the Longshot the crosshair vanished for a long time (the scope view was
  generated pixel by pixel; it's now a GPU shader).
